name: GoodHR 招聘助手
description: 查看 GoodHR 岗位和额度，一键启动候选人筛选任务并取回结果。招聘平台的登录状态和数据只保存在用户电脑本地。
description_zh: 查看 GoodHR 岗位和额度，一键启动候选人筛选任务并取回结果，招聘数据只保存在用户电脑本地。
description_en: View GoodHR job positions and quota, start candidate screening tasks with one click, and fetch the results. Recruitment data stays on the user's own computer.
examples_zh: 看看我的 GoodHR 岗位
帮我跑一遍「Java 高级工程师」岗位的筛选
把这次筛选出的候选人结果给我
examples_en: Start a screening run for the Senior Java Engineer position
How is the screening task going?
